rationale: Best-match scoring models actual host routing (one skill wins per phrasing) and reuses the already-implemented but dead _match_score(); fixes the OR-matching root cause instead of masking it.
rule: Option A — score-based best-match matcher for ll-verify-triggers
alternatives_rejected: B: min token overlap threshold — doesn't change OR-matching shape, still allows simultaneous multi-skill matches. C: warning-only collisions — leaves matcher broken, reopens BUG-2879's failing-on-the-wrong-thing problem for the collision metric.
